name: Emitter collector failing
description: One emit.py collector raised an error on 2 consecutive hourly runs (its source file is missing or malformed). Other collectors keep reporting.
programText:
c = data('grokbot.collector.ok')
detect(when(c < 1, lasting='1h15m')).publish('Emitter collector failing')

rules.parameterizedBody: Collector {{dimensions.collector}} failed on consecutive emits. Fix: run python3 bin/emit.py --dry-run and look at sources_fail; the error type is on the collector span in APM (service grokbot-emitter).
